follow-up time: From first or second trimester to third trimester
outcome: Prevalence and course of fear of childbirth
Risk factors for fear of childbirth
Influence of fear of childbirth on preferred mode of delivery
Self-reported need for help regarding fear of childbirth
finding: While fear of childbirth is common in each trimester, prevalence decreases over the course of pregnancy.
mod_finding: Women with fear of childbirth were more likely to prefer a cesarean section.
